description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services
  • Develop reusable and traceable infrastructure-as-code components using Terraform
  • Configure Azure networking, identity and access management, security controls, and resource governance
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, deployment, and release processes
  • Manage configurations across development, testing, staging, and production environments
  • Ensure deployments are controlled, reliable, repeatable, and auditable
  • Collaborate with architects, developers, platform teams, infrastructure specialists, and vendors on cloud and deployment solutions
  • Diagnose and resolve infrastructure, configuration, deployment, integration, and environment-related issues
  • Ensure cloud implementations meet security, scalability, performance, and maintainability requirements
  • Create and maintain infrastructure documentation and operational procedures
  • Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate, critically reviewing and validating their outputs
  • Follow established architectural standards, delivery processes, governance requirements, and quality controls
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering or DevOps within digital solution delivery environments
  • 3+ years of experience designing and implementing Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services
  • 3+ years of experience developing and managing infrastructure as code using Terraform
  • 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, deployment, and release processes
  • Hands-on experience with Azure networking, identity and access management, security controls, environment configuration, and resource governance
  • Experience supporting at least three distinct environment types, such as development, testing, staging, or production
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, troubleshooting, testing, code quality, and documentation, with critical review of outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with requirements
  • Understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, architectural approaches, system dependencies, and non-functional requirements
  • Experience working independently and within multidisciplinary teams in complex environments involving multiple teams, vendors, countries, or business functions
  • Experience delivering solutions within structured and/or Agile environments
  • Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units
  • Ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in accordance with information security, privacy, confidentiality, and data protection requirements
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or another relevant technical discipline
  • The degree must be awarded by a university ranked among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking
  • At least one relevant professional certification in Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps
